connexion.metaDescription: Log in to your Sécu'Cycle account to access your bikes and saved addresses.

motDePasseOublie.metaDescription: Reset the password for your Sécu'Cycle account.
motDePasseOublie.intro: Enter your email address: we will send you a code to reset your password.
motDePasseOublie.codeRenvoye: If an account exists, a new code has been sent.
motDePasseOublie.tropDeTentatives: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
motDePasseOublie.envoiImpossible: The code could not be sent right now.
motDePasseOublie.succes: Password reset. You can now log in.

identifiants.intro: Let's start with your email address and a password.
identifiants.tropCourt: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.

niveau.experimenteDescription: I ride a lot, and for long distances.

velos.nomInvalide: The name must be between 3 and 30 characters.
velos.erreurAjout: The bike could not be added. Please try again.

creationCompte.metaDescription: Join the Sécu'Cycle community and ride with peace of mind.
creationCompte.emailDejaUtilise: This email address is already in use, and the password does not match.
creationCompte.erreurCreation: Something went wrong while creating your account. Please try again.
creationCompte.codeRenvoye: If an unverified account exists, a new code has been sent.
creationCompte.tropDeTentatives: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
creationCompte.envoiImpossible: The code could not be sent right now.

changementEmail.metaDescription: Change the email address on your Sécu'Cycle account.
changementEmail.intro: We will send a {{longueur}}-digit code to your new address to check that it belongs to you.
changementEmail.alerteAncienneAdresse: We have also sent an alert to your current address. The change will only take effect once the code is confirmed.
changementEmail.codeRenvoye: A new code has been sent.
changementEmail.tropDeDemandes: Too many requests. Please try again later.
changementEmail.envoiImpossible: The code could not be sent right now.
changementEmail.succes: Your email address has been changed.

erreursDemande.emailPris: This email address is already used by another account.
erreursDemande.tropDeDemandes: Too many change requests. Please try again later.
erreursDemande.horsLigne: Connection failed. Please check your internet connection.
erreursDemande.generique: Something went wrong while sending the code.

erreursConfirmation.emailPris: This address has just been taken by another account. Please try a different one.
erreursConfirmation.tropDeTentatives: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
erreursConfirmation.horsLigne: Connection failed. Please check your internet connection.
erreursConfirmation.generique: Something went wrong while confirming the change.

profil.metaDescription: Manage your personal details, addresses, bikes and navigation history.
